final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Customer.Segment = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Customer.Segment = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM customers AS Customer
JOIN gasstations AS GasStation ON Customer.GasStationID = GasStation.GasStationID
JOIN products AS Product ON Customer.CustomerID = Product.ProductID
